skeleton Q {
    memory { s: Map<String, Int> [persistent]
             t: Map<String, Int> [persistent] }
    state fl {
        initial: a
        a -> b
        a -> x
        b -> x
        * -> dead except [x]
    }
    face {
        signal st(id: String) -> String   reads fl
        signal go(id: String) -> Int      
        signal wr(id: String) -> Int      writes s, t
        signal ev(id: String)             writes s
    }
}
skeleton W {
    face {
        signal go(id: String) -> Int      
    }
}
flesh Q {
    on st(id) { return get_status(id) ?? "a" }
    on go(id) { return s.get(id) ?? 0 }
    on wr(id) { s.set(id, 1)  t.set(id, 1)  return 1 }
    on ev(id) { s.set(id, 2) }
}
flesh W {
    on go(id) { return 1 }
}
